chunks.text: Next we will talk about pairs in an array
So the name of this question is pairs in an array
That means we have to find all possible pairs of all the elements stored in our array
Pairs means when two people are joined together, we call it pair
So if we join any number with any number, then it will be a pair
So we have to find all possible pairs
Let's see how to find all possible pairs
Now the logical way is this, first of all we will discuss the logical way
First of all, let's find all possible pairs of 2
2 should not pair with 2, it should pair up with other numbers
So if we pair 2 with 4, then it becomes a pair of 2 and 4
If we pair 2 with 6, then it becomes a pair of 2 and 6
If we pair 2 with 8, then it becomes a pair of 2 and 8
And if we pair 2 with 10, then it becomes a pair of 2 and 10
So these are our 4 pairs here
After that, let's find all possible pairs of 4
In pairs of 4, first of all, its pair is already formed with 2
That is 2, 4 and 4, 2
These two are same
Whether you pair 2 with 4 or 4 with 2, it is same
We don't have to differentiate in this
So 4 pairs are already formed with 2, that is, it is formed with the left pair
On the right, 4 pairs are formed with 6
4 pairs are formed with 8
And 4 pairs are formed with 10
Now if we have to make pairs of 6, then how will 6 pairs be formed?
6 pairs are formed with 2, that is, this and 6 pairs are formed with 4
That is, this is already formed
Now if we have to make pairs of 6 with 8, then this is formed
If we have to make pairs of 6 with 10, then this is formed
In the end, the last pair will be 8
8 pairs were formed with 10, and 8 pairs were formed with 10
So here 3 pairs were formed, 2 pairs were formed here, and 1 pair was formed here
So how can we make all possible pairs in this way?
The number we are on, let's say we have to make pairs of 2
So all the numbers before that,
Do them one by one and get them joined together and print that pair
The concept we will use here is nested loops
Nested loop means loop inside the loop
What is the logic?
First of all, we run the loop for all the elements of the array
So the first turn came in the loop of 2
We joined 2 with 4, 2 joined with 6, 2 joined with 8, and 2 joined with 10
Then the turn came in the loop of 4
We ran another loop for 4
4 joined with 6, 4 joined with 8, and 4 joined with 10
Then the turn came again for 6
We joined 6 with 8, and then 6 joined with 10
So in this way, we will use nested loops inside the loop
What will we write in the outer loop?
We will write the elements of the array in the outer loop
How will the code look?
The code will look something like this
For int i equals 0 to n
For the current number, we will run another loop
For int j equals current, we will name it i plus 1 to n
And here we will print all the pairs
What is the logic behind this?
First of all, the turn will come for 2
For 2, whose turn will come?
Which index will start after 2?
If the index of 2 is i, then which index will start from i plus 1?
After that, we will do for 4
For 4, the turn will come for 6, 8, and 10
For 6, the turn will come for 8 and 10
Similarly, the turn will come for 8 only
And no turn will come for 10
Because as soon as 10 comes after 8, i equals n minus 1 for 10
So the loop from n to n will not work here
So no pair will be printed with 10
Later, all the pairs of 10 will be printed
So the logic of nested loop will be to print pairs
For this, let's understand it by writing code
First of all, let's write a function to print pairs
If we do all the work in the function, then modularity is formed in the code
If you know that you have to do this work, then see this function
If you want to do this work, then see this function
It feels good to see the code

It will print pairs

For int i equals 0, i plus plus will not become numbers dot length
Now our current is numbers of i
Let's write it as curr
So in first bar, current will be 2, then 4, 6, 8, 10
Now for every current, it will have an inner loop
j is equal to i plus 1, this loop will start
j is less than numbers dot length, this loop will go

Because of which there will be an error in their code
This is a very common mistake that beginners do

So I am telling you that in every variable loop, there is an updation in j

Then we have to make pair of 2 with 8
Then we have to make pair of 2 with 10

In this inner loop

So what happened here, 2 is stored in current
After that, this loop will run from 4 to 10 for 2
First pair was made with 4, then with 6, then with 8, then with 10

4 with 6, 4 with 8, 4 with 10

Total pairs are 10
4 plus 3 is 7, plus 2 is 9, plus 1 is 10
In fact, you will notice that every time the pairs are less than 1
So there is a formula to get total number of pairs
If n elements are there in an array
Then the formula to get total pairs is tp
n into n minus 1 by 2

Where did this logic come from?
Because there are 5 elements, then first 4 pairs will be made
Then 3 pairs will be made

n into n minus 1 by 2

Sum of AP

n square

n plus n minus 1 plus n minus 2 plus n minus 3
